details: Standard Chartered analyst Geoffrey Kendrick has suggested that Bitcoin's price has likely bottomed out around $59,000, signaling the end of the crypto winter. This outlook is supported by factors such as a reduction in spot Bitcoin ETF redemption pressure following the SpaceX IPO and easing oil prices.
title: Standard Chartered Declares Bitcoin Bottom at $59K, Signals End of Crypto Winter

details: Michael Saylor, Executive Chairman of MicroStrategy, stated that 25% of the "Magnificent 8" technology companies now hold Bitcoin on their balance sheets, following Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO. This highlights increasing institutional adoption of Bitcoin.
title: Saylor: 25% of "Magnificent 8" Now Hold Bitcoin Post-SpaceX IPO

details: A report from Coinbase's Independent Advisory Board on Quantum Computing and Blockchain estimates that approximately 7 million Bitcoin are vulnerable to future quantum attacks due to public key exposure and address reuse. The report urges the community to begin preparations for post-quantum migration.
title: Coinbase Report Warns Millions of Bitcoin at Risk from Quantum Threat via Address Reuse

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $85.9 million in net inflows on June 12, ending a five-day outflow streak. In contrast, spot Ethereum ETFs continued to experience net outflows, logging approximately $4.95 million, indicating a divergence in investor sentiment between the two largest cryptocurrencies.
title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs See Inflows, Ethereum Funds Continue Outflows

details: RippleX has launched the XRPL AI Starter Kit, providing tools for developers to build AI-powered payment applications on the XRP Ledger. This initiative supports autonomous AI agents making payments using XRP and Ripple USD (RLUSD), positioning XRP for the emerging "agentic payments" economy.
title: Ripple's XRPL AI Starter Kit Enables AI Agent Payments with XRP

details: Tokens associated with decentralized AI projects like Venice (VVV) and Morpheus (MOR) have rallied following a U.S. government order restricting access to Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models. This event is fueling the narrative for permissionless and censorship-resistant decentralized AI solutions.
title: Decentralized AI Tokens Surge After US Ban on Anthropic's Fable 5

details: An AI-powered security audit conducted by Anthropic's Mythos tool on the Zcash protocol found no additional serious vulnerabilities. This positive outcome follows a recent disclosure of a critical bug in Zcash's Orchard shielded pool, boosting confidence in the privacy coin's security.
title: Zcash Audit by Anthropic's AI Finds No New Critical Bugs

details: Despite relatively flat price performance, Litecoin (LTC) has seen a 7% increase in whale and shark wallets holding at least 10,000 LTC over the past five months. This accumulation, coupled with renewed interest in the LitVM project aiming to bring smart contract functionality to Litecoin, suggests potential for future growth.
title: Litecoin Sees Whale Accumulation Amidst Growing LitVM Interest
